name: Parham Panel
changelog: Separated UI assets into css/ and js/ (index, login, sub), persisted scanner/SNI results, automatic expiry and traffic enforcement for Xray users, fully configurable inbound client options (SNI, fingerprint, ALPN, host, flow, advanced JSON), configurable config name prefix (empty by default), bundled scanner seed lists, and a custom use-and-share LICENSE (no modification, no selling).
